ai.mindconnect:mc-agent-chat-ui-rest 0.0.3 发布, The chat UI — message list, composer, attachments and the streaming
        turn view, as UiNode-rendering components and the controllers that
        serve them. A library, like mc-agent-api-rest: no Spring Boot main
        class, so a host app decides how it is wired and secured.

        This is the lower of the two UI modules: the admin UI depends on it
        for its own chat page, not the other way round. A user-facing chat
        must not have to ship agent CRUD, LLM configs, traces and migrations.

        fetch single-page-app sites that the plain-HTTP mc-agent-tools-web
        can't see (JavaScript-rendered content, cookie/consent banners that
        block static fetches, etc.).

        Kept as a separate module from mc-agent-tools-web because it pulls
        in a ~150MB Chromium download on first use — apps that don't want
        that footprint can leave this off their classpath.
